title: Question 14
passage:
If someone spots a typo in the signed letter, should they fix the file or tell you first?
A. Tell me first. I need to arrange a new signature if the text changes. B. I sent the first copy to the front office. C. We use the same letterhead every month.
passageZh:
如果有人發現簽過名的信件有打字錯誤，應直接改檔，還是先告訴你？
A. 先通知我。文字如果改了，我需要安排重新簽名。 B. 我把第一份副本送到行政辦公室了。 C. 我們每個月沿用相同的信紙抬頭。
